State banks sit on a pile of unlent deposits
items.description: Six state-owned banks are collecting far more deposits than a year ago but are barely lending out the additional funds, a finance ministry report shows.

items.title: Padma Bank’s fate rests on undefined ‘resolution measure’
items.description: Bangladesh Bank (BB) yesterday said it would adopt and implement an “effective and appropriate resolution measure” for Padma Bank PLC, but did not specify what the measure would involve or when it would take effect.

items.title: US targets chip smuggling to China after Huang’s return to Nvidia
items.description: Singapore agreed Tuesday to cooperate with the United States after it added the company at the centre of the Nvidia scandal to a trade backlist, following CEO Jensen Huang’s stunning return to the helm of the US chip giant.
